alert_name: Sudo GTFOBins Privilege Escalation via Find
evidence: User executed sudo privilege enumeration using 'sudo -l'
Privilege transition observed from uid=1000 to euid=0
Root shell subsequently executed discovery commands
risk_summary: A user abused sudo permissions to execute the GTFOBins find technique and spawn an interactive root shell, resulting in successful privilege escalation.
recommended_actions: Review sudoers configuration for unnecessary command permissions
Investigate activity performed from the spawned root shell
Validate legitimacy of the user's administrative actions
Restrict GTFOBins-capable binaries from sudo where possible
